column7: Open-source Minecraft launcher for managing isolated 1.20.1 instances, Java versions, and modpacks.
Mod loader for Minecraft 1.20.1 required to load JourneyMap and OptiFine on the client.
Client rendering optimization, dynamic lighting, zoom, connected textures, and shader pack support.
Real-time in-game minimap, fullscreen world map, and death/waypoint markers for players.
Core permissions & role management system (groups, prefixes, command access) with web editor support; loads before Vault.
Permissions, chat, and economy abstraction API bridging LuckPerms with EssentialsX and Multiverse.
Foundational server utility suite providing warps, homes, teleportation (/tpa), kits, economy, and moderation commands.
Permission-based block placement, breaking, crafting, and item-drop restrictions per group or item ID.
Chat formatting addon that renders LuckPerms prefixes/suffixes, group colors, and local/shout chat channels.
Global world rules enforcement (creeper/TNT explosion prevention, fire spread, mob griefing, weather locks).
Manages server spawn points (/setspawn, /spawn), first-join spawn locations, and per-group respawn routing.
Multi-world management engine allowing multiple simultaneous worlds (lobby, survival, creative, resource worlds) with independent game rules.
Isolates player inventories, XP, health, hunger, and Ender Chests between world groups (e.g., preventing creative items in survival).
Links vanilla Nether and End portals to specific custom Multiverse worlds so each Overworld has its own Nether/End.
Custom-shaped travel portals between worlds or locations (selected with WorldEdit wand) for hubs and lobbies.
Allows clickable teleportation signs ([mv] signs) or sign-attached portals to route players to target worlds/destinations.
In-game map editor (selections,schematics, brushes, copy/paste) and required region-selection dependency for WorldGuard and Multiverse-Portals.
Region-based protection and flag system (spawn protection, PvP zones, build permissions, mob-spawning flags); requires WorldEdit.
